h: 此工作流程是之前发布的工作流程的一部分暗行者后来被替换/分割成多个更复杂的。将此发布作为对那些想知道我用来生成视频以及如何制作视频的人的答案。有关我的方法的更多具体信息，请参阅带有视频本身的帖子，因为那里通常有描述。

o.en: This workflow is a piece of a workflow, that was previously posted byDarkSideWalkerand later replaced/splited into multiple more complicated ones. Posting this as an answer for people, who whant to know, what I used to generate videos and how I do it. For more specific information about my methods see posts with videos themselves, as there is usually a description there.
